data.one_liner: Hides or shows a bottom navigation bar while scrolling.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to attach a ScrollController to automatically show or hide a bottom navigation bar when scrolling up or down. Supports additional features like snap behavior, pinning, FAB, and snackbars.
use_when: You want to maximize screen estate by hiding the bottom navigation bar during scrolling.
You need snap behavior or pin/unpin controls for a bottom navigation bar.
avoid_when: You do not need scroll-aware bottom navigation hiding.
Your application architecture relies entirely on platform primitives that handle this natively without custom scroll controllers.
strengths: Supports snap behavior, pin/unpin states, FABs, and snackbars.
Simple integration via extensions on ScrollController.
weaknesses: Limited to bottom navigation bars tied to a custom ScrollController extension.
Few recent updates documented beyond the null-safety release in v4.0.0.
